items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: So Gladys told me that we were going to this dance at the Lion's Club... And Danny came to the dance... So he came by Gladys' house. And he was supposed to be coming to Gladys, but I must have looked good to him, because he'd come to see me.

ctx.x: Because we used to dance... You see, everybody would dance in a show. When we would be rehearsing, they would be up there rehearsing, and we'd do everybody's song and everybody's dance -- and you could look at 'em. We'd know everybody's routine. So that was the deal.
And Gladys used to sing the Blues.
